content: These ten samples make up a single questionnaire presented in full to each participant evaluating the corresponding character, and the participant is asked to select the single top response they think the character would most likely respond with for each of the ten initial dialogue lines. See Figure FIGREF41 for an example. We mask any character names within the candidate responses to prevent human participants from using names to identify which show the response is from.
